title: Exterior sheaf and its canonical maps on a ringed site
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site small relative to the coefficient universe [def-weil-size-convention] [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], $B$ a sheaf of commutative rings and $Q$ a sheaf of $B$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For $n\in\mathbf N$, form the existing sectionwise exterior-power presheaf $W_n(Q)(U)=\bigwedge^n_{B(U)}Q(U)$ [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra], whose semilinear restrictions send a pure wedge to the wedge of the restrictions. Define $\operatorname{ExtSh}_B^n(Q)=W_n(Q)^\#$ by module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Its wedge of sections is the sectionwise wedge followed by the sheafification unit, including the empty wedge when $n=0$. For a morphism $g:Q\to Q'$, the sectionwise exterior linear maps $\bigwedge^n g_U$ commute with every restriction: the two composites along $f:V\to U$ are equal as $B(U)$-linear maps to $W_n(Q')(V)$ with its restricted scalar action. Define $W_n(g)$ to have these actual sectionwise maps, using that naturality equality, and define $\operatorname{ExtSh}_B^n(g)$ to be its image under module sheafification. Thus all object and map data use the canonical exterior-power construction and sheafification.
